so3_cost_comparison_20261012.question: Does SO3 group integration add unacceptable measured cost despite a smaller velocity head, under the same available input and candidate budget?
so3_cost_comparison_20261012.tool: Extend existing profile.py with an opt-in single-model representation control; no additional benchmark or audit infrastructure
so3_cost_comparison_20261012.input: One fixed typed observation from analytic SMPLH identity/beta0/Tz3 projected by existing fixture rig, float32 CUDA, CPUthreads1; fixture_normalization and authorized local male/MANO/COCO assets. Reset causal state toNone each call; no video/detector/labels/checkpoint.
so3_cost_comparison_20261012.initialization: Seed7; copy matching StateEncoder/Transformer and other common parameters from ambient toSO3, leaving differently sized pose heads explicit. Random weights measure structure cost only.
so3_cost_comparison_20261012.timing: Two warmups per mode; 8 recorded repetitions per mode with cyclic order to balance execution-order drift. Synchronize at each boundary. Record infer outer API, decode, A4 whole-candidate decision, and complete total; no time-based tuning, repeats or candidate selection.
so3_cost_comparison_20261012.memory: Per mode CUDA allocator baseline and peak/increment; both models and one surface resident for all modes, no process-wide memory claim
so3_cost_comparison_20261012.retain: Every repetition, numerical/action counts and rejection reasons; decode all numeric candidates, no best-run filter. A4 selects one complete candidate, no geometry/J cost or visual quality inferred.
so3_cost_comparison_20261012.success: Positive full results for all four fixed controls with budget/decoder counts consistent. A SO3/ambient fullp50 ratio >1.25 or fewer legal candidates stops cost-based promotion. Report fullp95 versus33.3ms only as this typed-pixel boundary, not full-system30fps.
so3_cost_comparison_20261012.stop: Single fixed run; preserve failures; no repeats merely for stable-looking numbers. Do not removeG0/G1/J or claim efficacy from timings. If extra SO3 cost dominates, only one justified numerical-kernel replacement can be considered under the two-revision rule.

result.scope: Random weights/small fixedGPUsample only; no capture/detector/G0J/quality comparison. No stable deployed speed or efficacy certification.

so3_representation_factor_20261012.mechanism: SO3 angular velocity replaces ambient6D pose velocity; right group Euler replaces additive pose Euler, with a matched independent Haar base and linear train/inference path. This is one coherent rotation-geometry factor, not independent source/schedule tricks.
so3_representation_factor_20261012.inputs: Existing Observation/StateEncoder context, complete Labels and existing training-only Normalization. Tests use explicit analytic fixtures; no optimizer or weights.
so3_representation_factor_20261012.controls: Existing ambient F0 and same SO3 model deterministic regression using existing regression_loss; both retain original128width/4heads/4blocks and observations. Information projections remain allocated but inactive inF0; noLambda is passed.
so3_representation_factor_20261012.capacity: Only pose_out changes128to6 to128to3, reducing387parameters; remaining architecture unchanged. SO3 regression andCFM exactly same capacity; report difference from ambient rather than calling it an exact capacity match.
so3_representation_factor_20261012.source: Reuse existing per-candidate seeded6N+13 Gaussian noise, first4 iid components per rotation normalized to a unit quaternion; two unused Gaussian components per rotation do not enter dynamics. Same law used for CFM and sampling; retain explicit failure for invalid externally supplied base, never redraw.
so3_representation_factor_20261012.path: Frozen endpoint CPU SciPy principal log; R(t)=R0*Exp(t*skew(omega)), body angular targetomega. Standardized T/beta use original linear Gaussian path; no label-derived inference input.
so3_representation_factor_20261012.loss: Equal three blocks: mean angular-coordinate squared error (scaled canonical SO3 metric, fixed1rad units), standardized T3 MSE, standardized beta10 MSE. Regression retains existing standardized6D/T/beta MSE; training losses are not an efficacy comparison.
so3_representation_factor_20261012.scope: New isolated so3_flow.py; small opt-in loss dispatch and normalization/solver metadata in existing train.py/candidate_store.py; existing test_joint.py extended. No default model/config/mainline/checkpoint changes.
checks: Frozen identity/regular/nearpi path reaches source/target; rejects endpoint gradients rather than silently using CPU detach for guidance
Constant angular/body velocity and T/beta velocity reach independently specified closed-form endpoint; right/left update convention and nonuniform normalization checked
CFM and regression finite with active gradients inpose/T/beta and Transformer; incomplete labels rejected; no optimizer updates
Existing candidate publication masks/no-current-observation and causal state reused; wrong normalization rejected; measured head capacity within ceiling
New branch and directly affected existing tests only, plus changed-file Ruff/syntax checks
so3_representation_factor_20261012.success: A coherent opt-in angular-velocity model with same-condition regression and existing publication interface; endpoint/gradient/legal-state checks pass without extra neural modules. This does not establish accuracy, calibration, runtime or necessity ofG0/G1/J.
so3_representation_factor_20261012.stop: Stop if geometry requires extra proposal/quality models, fails legal/endpoints or exceeds capacity; at most2 reasonable revisions. Do not promote or train without existing independent data/authorization gates.
so3_representation_factor_20261012.novelty: SO3 flow matching and group integration have RFM/FrameFlow/FoldFlow precedents; this implementation alone is not a research novelty claim.
